title: Daloopa, which structures financial data from filings, transcripts, investor decks, and other public sources for investment firms, raised a $47M Series C (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Daloopa, which structures financial data from filings, transcripts, investor decks, and other public sources for investment firms, raised a $47M Series C — Daloopa, which provides source-linked financial data for investment firms, raised $47 million in Series C funding led by Brighton Park Capital …
